# Ryan/Justin - Touch base
Date: 2026-11-03 | Duration: 20m

## Summary
The discussion covered GrowthBook’s uncertain hiring outlook, territory planning, business performance, and next steps. Q4 planning is underway for next year’s priorities and headcount, with a board meeting scheduled for the following week; hiring expectations should become clearer afterward, although revisions may take several weeks. A position could become available in December, but no commitment has been made while go-to-market planning continues. Future needs could potentially reach six representatives, and Ryan McGurk expects the company will eventually hire one additional AE, possibly more, depending on growth and whether another funding round occurs. The company is considering a second Bay Area representative despite limited inbound volume, while marketing works to generate more demand among technology companies. Justin H. remains open to Bay Area, Eastern, New York, California, and broader West Coast territories. Ryan described Q3 as really good, and multiple deals entered during October’s final two weeks, strengthening the Q4 pipeline. Justin plans to reconnect in the first week of December, while both parties will share updates if circumstances change.

## Keywords
GrowthBook hiring, Headcount planning, Bay Area sales territory, Account executive hiring, Q4 pipeline, Board meeting

## Action Items
**Ryan McGurk**
Review GrowthBook growth, funding, headcount, and hiring plans (04:10)
Provide Justin update (05:53)

**Justin H.**
Notify Ryan of offer-stage opportunities (05:29)
Schedule follow-up with Ryan (05:40)
Share job search changes (05:40)
